text:
Perfect! I've successfully integrated the Porsche Design System into your Astro + Vue application. Here's what was accomplished:

## ✅ Integration Complete

**1. Porsche Design System Installation**
- ✅ Installed `@porsche-design-system/components-js@3.29.0`
- ✅ Vue was already installed and configured

**2. Configuration Updates**
- ✅ Updated `astro.config.mjs` to support Porsche Design System components in Vue
- ✅ Added custom element recognition for `p-` prefixed components

**3. Layout Integration**
- ✅ Added all recommended Porsche Design System partials to `Layout.astro`
- ✅ Integrated loader script, font optimization, and performance enhancements
- ✅ Added component chunk preloading and icon optimization

**4. Vue Components Created**
- ✅ `PorscheHeader.vue` - Header with Porsche wordmark and navigation
- ✅ `PorscheServiceCard.vue` - Service cards using Porsche typography
- ✅ `PorscheHero.vue` - Hero section with Porsche button and heading components

**5. Demo Page**
- ✅ Created `/porsche-demo` page showcasing Porsche Design System components
- ✅ Added navigation link to access the demo
- ✅ Integrated Porsche components with existing content

## 🚀 Key Features

**Performance Optimizations:**
- Font preloading to minimize FOUT (Flash of Unstyled Text)
- Component chunk preloading for faster hydration
- Icon preloading to prevent FOUC (Flash of Unstyled Content)
- Optimized initial styles for better loading experience

**Design Consistency:**
- Porsche Design System provides consistent typography, spacing, and components
- Professional, premium aesthetic that enhances the de-Googling content
- Responsive design that works across all devices

**Component Library:**
- `p-wordmark` - Porsche logo integration
- `p-heading` - Consistent typography hierarchy
- `p-text` - Styled text components
- `p-link` - Navigation links with proper styling
- `p-button` - Interactive button components

Your website now combines the modern, clean design with the premium Porsche Design System components. Visit `/porsche-demo` to see the integration in action, or check the updated home page for the new demo section!

The integration maintains all existing functionality while adding the professional polish of the Porsche Design System.
